summary: Extend the auto-retry budget (backoff capped at 30s/attempt, ~10 min total) for EHOSTDOWN/EHOSTUNREACH/ENETUNREACH/ETIMEDOUT/ECONNRESET/socket-hang-up errors against a local or LAN model host, and for ECONNREFUSED on a non-loopback LAN host; keep the normal budget with a "server not running" hint for ECONNREFUSED on loopback, and show a stderr retry line plus Ctrl+C cancellation in text/print mode.
